mapper.select: SELECT 0 AS position,'difference_open' AS metric,COUNT(*) AS count_lower_bound,MIN(created_at) AS oldest_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AS observed_at FROM (SELECT created_at FROM tc_reconciliation_case FORCE INDEX(ix_recon_case_observation) WHERE status='OPEN' ORDER BY created_at,id LIMIT 10001) AS bounded_difference_open UNION ALL SELECT 1 AS position,'difference_processing' AS metric,COUNT(*) AS count_lower_bound,MIN(created_at) AS oldest_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AS observed_at FROM (SELECT created_at FROM tc_reconciliation_case FORCE INDEX(ix_recon_case_observation) WHERE status='PROCESSING' ORDER BY created_at,id LIMIT 10001) AS bounded_difference_processing ORDER BY position
